description: This file defines the ITransactionalResourceExtension interface for transaction-related extensions in Orleans. It declares methods for commit, abort, cancel, confirm, and prepare operations on transactional resources, with attributes indicating transactional behavior.

classes.name: ITransactionalResourceExtension
classes.description: An interface that extends IGrainExtension, providing methods for transactional resource management, including commit, abort, cancel, confirm, and prepare operations with associated attributes for transactional behavior.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Performs a read-only commit operation on a transactional resource, returning a TransactionalStatus.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts a transaction identified by transactionId for a specific resource.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a transaction with given resourceId, transactionId, timestamp, and status.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms a transaction identified by resourceId and transactionId at a given timestamp.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a transaction on a resource for commit, with access counters, timestamp, and transaction manager participant ID.
